b: The Portuguese event returns for its third edition in January
SQUARE festival has added a second wave of acts to the lineup for its third edition, taking place in January.

Returning to its main base of Braga, the Portuguese event will newly take in performances from UK rapper Nadeem Din-Gabisi; Mozambican multi-instrumentalist Cheny Wa Gune; Cape Verde's Leydy Indira; and Unganisha, the duo of Kenyan singer and orutu player Labdi Ommes andNorwegian electronic musician Bernt Isak Wærstad.

The latest announcement also includes Dutch bubbling house pioneer and Nyege Nyege Tapes affiliate Shaun D; Mexican singer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist La Bruja de Texcoco; and New York guitar pop band Diary; among others.
